_about: 7.1.0-dev.2 assistant identity, shared rules (same idea as realtime_intents.json): backend identity.py (test_identity_wake_712.py), the web app's validateAssistantName/identityAnswer (tests/js/identity_harness.js) and Android chat/Identity.kt (IdentityTest). 'names': raw input -> the clean name, or null when it must be refused. 'questions': message -> 'name' (identity answer), 'rename' (how to rename) or null (not an identity question; the model answers).

names.in: A very long assistant name x

questions.q: What is your name for the variable in this code?
Who are you voting for in the election article?
What is the name of the largest planet?
